_notes: Single source of truth for the bio page. Add one object per tool. affiliateUrl: leave null for non-affiliate tools; while an application is pending, keep the {{PLACEHOLDER}} string - the page treats any value containing '{{' as 'not live yet', links to the official url instead, and hides the Affiliate tag. featuredDate: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the first video featuring the tool, or null. Future dates render as 'Video drops <date>'.

tools.name: ChatGPT Intelligent UI
tools.oneLiner: Ask ChatGPT for a bill splitter, map or tap-through diagram and it builds a working mini-app right in the chat.
